label: Why total IT jobs hold while their employer changes
story: AI raises output per worker, so fewer staff are needed for the same work. At the same time GCCs win work from vendors and their scale advantage feeds itself, so total IT staff moves less than the split between employers.

label: Staffing catches up with the work
The GCC scale loop
story: Every GCC that opens makes the next one easier; the work it takes comes out of vendors' books, and GCC hiring from vendors raises their costs. The advantage is capped: the loop feeds back until about 2032, then sits at its cap, a fixed shift with no further gain.
